name: fact_sales
description: Beverage sales at the source reporting grain: one row per received sales occurrence.

columns.name: date_key
columns.description: Calendar date identifier in YYYYMMDD format.

columns.name: product_key
columns.description: Deterministic identifier of a beverage brand/flavor and packaging presentation.

columns.name: region_key
columns.description: Deterministic identifier of the sales region.

columns.name: channel_key
columns.description: Deterministic identifier of the classified sales channel.

columns.name: channel_group
columns.description: Sales reporting channel grouping, distinct from the trade group classification.

columns.name: period
columns.description: Reporting period identifier supplied with the sales record.

columns.name: sales_amount
columns.description: Monetary sales amount, including negative and zero values; currency is unspecified.

columns.name: _source_file_path
columns.description: Path of the original file containing the sales record.

columns.name: _silver_run_id
columns.description: Silver execution identifier associated with the sales record.

gold_fact_references_exist.description: Checks that every sale references existing calendar, product, region and channel dimension members.
